description: Join a Markasso live session (link with ?live=...) and draw on that board in real time. If the room has content it becomes the current diagram; if it is empty, the current diagram is published to it.

link.description: Live session link from Markasso (⋯ More tools > Start live session, or the prompt from Invite AI agent)

name.description: Name shown to people in the room (default "AI agent")
